item.name: Get Active Delivery Zones By Store

request.description: Returns active delivery zones for the selected store. No authentication is required.
Returns all delivery zones for the selected store. Uses AdminToken.
Returns delivery-zone details and its assigned governorate areas.
Creates a delivery zone and assigns governorate areas. Set freeDeliveryMinimumAmount to null for no free delivery, or 0 for always-free delivery.
Updates the delivery zone. The submitted governorateAreaIds list fully replaces the existing assignments.
Disables the selected delivery zone. Checkout must reject addresses covered only by inactive zones.
Enables the selected delivery zone.
